resources.string: This screen is a placeholder for upcoming settings.
Transfer and chat settings will be added in a later release.
Choose one or more files and enter the same room password as your Windows peer.
Enter the room password used on the sending device. Received files are saved to your configured folder when possible; otherwise they remain in private app storage for export.
Copying file to the selected destination…
Could not prepare the selected files
This file provider did not grant persistent folder access. Choose another folder or enter a path.
Keep Crocaun open during transfer. Background service, cancellation, and byte-level progress are still in development.
Enter an absolute file or folder path per line. Crocaun copies readable files into private staging before sending.
Copying files from the entered paths…

Android may block paths in shared storage. If needed, you can explicitly grant All files access in Settings. This is broad access to shared files; it is not enabled automatically and may be restricted for Google Play distribution.
All files access is enabled for Crocaun.
Could not open Android All files access settings.
Search for Windows Crocaun devices in Exchange mode. Selecting one sends through its local relay instead of a public relay.
Search for a Windows Crocaun sender waiting for a receiver on the local network.
Test the public Croc relay servers with the same ping/pong protocol used by Windows Crocaun.
Choose a folder with a file manager
Folder contents are sent as individual files; the Croc transfer protocol does not preserve nested folder structure.
Preparing files from the selected folder…
Saved %1$d file(s). %2$d file(s) remain available for export.
Choose receive folder with a file manager
A SAF folder is selected. Received files will be saved there.
SAF folder selection is preferred. A manual path may require Android All files access; failed saves stay available below.
Safely unpack received ZIP files (keep original archives)
Not implemented yet. Proxy settings will appear here only after proxy routing works for the supported network features; no inactive proxy controls are shown.
